name: Cushman & Wakefield

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Cushman & Wakefield logo.svg, hosted on Commons)

description: Cushman & Wakefield is one of the three largest commercial real estate service firms in the world and, like its peers, owns no buildings: clients pay it fees. Two-thirds of 2025 revenue comes from the Services line (facility, property and project management, much of it costs passed through to clients), which is contracted and recurring. The profit swing factor is the transaction lines: Leasing (commission on rent committed in signed leases), Capital markets (commission on property sales and financings, +19 percent in 2025) and Valuation and other. It carries heavy debt (about $216 million of net interest in 2025 against $656 million of Adjusted EBITDA) and in 2025 wrote off $177 million of its stake in the Greystone mortgage joint venture. Earnings are lowest in Q1 and highest in Q4.

sub.name: Property brokers, managers, data and listings

employees.note: Approximately; about 67% in the Americas, 10% EMEA, 23% APAC; costs of about 45% of employees are fully reimbursed by clients; about 7,000 (13%) under collective bargaining agreements (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Americas
businessLines.how: See the four service lines below; in the Americas the leasing and capital markets professionals are mainly paid commission (FY2025 10-K).
businessLines.description: United States, Canada and other North and South America; the US alone was 69% of group revenue.

businessLines.name: EMEA
businessLines.how: Same four service lines; leasing and capital markets staff in EMEA are salaried with a performance bonus rather than pure commission.
businessLines.description: UK, France, Netherlands and other Europe, Middle East and Africa.

businessLines.name: APAC
businessLines.how: See the four service lines below; APAC is the most Services-weighted segment (Services is 68% of its fee revenue vs 50% in the Americas, derived) and has the lowest Adjusted EBITDA margin of the three (4.4%).
businessLines.description: Australia, Singapore, India and other Asia Pacific (Australia 5% and Singapore about 4% of group revenue).

businessLines.name: Services (service line, all segments)
businessLines.how: Occupiers and building owners pay a fixed monthly fee, an hours-based fee, a mark-up on cost or a percentage of gross receipts to run facilities and properties, and they also reimburse the engineers, landscapers and staff the firm hires on their behalf. Contracts run several years with high switching costs.
businessLines.description: Property management, facilities management and services, and project management; the largest line, generally recurring under multi-year contracts.

revenue.note: Fee revenue only. The 10-K states Services is 66% of total 2025 revenue (51% of service line fee revenue), which includes the $3,226.9M of gross contract reimbursables; fee revenue alone is 35% of total revenue (derived).

businessLines.revenueNote: Fee revenue only. The 10-K states Services is 66% of total 2025 revenue (51% of service line fee revenue), which includes the $3,226.9M of gross contract reimbursables; fee revenue alone is 35% of total revenue (derived).

businessLines.name: Leasing (service line)
businessLines.how: A one-time fee after a lease is signed, calculated as a percentage of the total rent payable over the lease life, paid by the landlord or the tenant who engaged the firm.
businessLines.description: Owner representation (for landlords) and tenant representation (renewals, expansions, relocations).

businessLines.name: Capital markets (service line)
businessLines.how: A fee at closing equal to a percentage of the deal value; income follows transaction volume and velocity in the property market.
businessLines.description: Representing buyers and sellers of property and arranging equity, debt and structured financing.

businessLines.name: Valuation and other (service line)
businessLines.how: Fees per engagement, mostly fixed by scope, with some transaction-based fees.
businessLines.description: Appraisal management, valuation advisory, portfolio and diligence advisory, dispute and litigation support, plus investment management.

brands.name: Cushman & Wakefield
brands.share: Primary operating brand, 100% of revenue; acquisitions are moved onto it (FY2025 10-K)

brands.segment: Equity-method mortgage origination and servicing venture
